# Barney Pullen & Odette Pullen

## Shared scenes

> In her room at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gets dressed for a charity concert with help and advice from Isolde and [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Afterward, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) and [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) arrive to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). Upon arriving, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is overwhelmed by the elegant crowd and suffers severe stage fright when called to perform.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) overcomes a wave of severe stage fright when she spots [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) smiling in the back of the hall, which spurs her determination not to let him mock her. Her initial recitation and encore earn high praise from the audience and notable attendees. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) enjoy supper and depart together, reflecting cheerfully on the evening as [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) waits outside.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P31](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0031)_

> In bed on New Year's Eve, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) proposes marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her bashful brother, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly declines the proposal, causing [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) to react with cool indifference and note that [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) will likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead. After [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) leaves the next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) laughs over the unromantic reality of her very first marriage proposal.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Nell’s First Proposal

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Proposal P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and observes subtle changes around town, including [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) Pullen's marriage and Odette's plan to move West. She learns from Mrs. Sowerby that her friend [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) is gravely ill with consumption. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde drop off jelly at Aunt Drusilla's home, enduring her unpleasant remarks before continuing on to visit Opal, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confides her secret ambition to write a story.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life
